definitions: Pleasing and attractive in appearance, especially of a man.
Of a woman, having a striking, stately, and dignified appearance rather than delicate or conventionally pretty.
Of a thing, well-proportioned, substantial, and attractive.
Generous or considerable in amount or size.
examples: He was a tall, handsome man.
She was a handsome woman with a strong profile.
They lived in a handsome Victorian house.
He made a handsome profit on the deal.
